## Purpose
This is the `docgen` tool — it auto-generates per-directory `AUTO_DOCS.md` files for Claude agents by feeding each directory's file content to `claude -p`, then injects those docs as pre-tool context via a Claude Code hook. It exists so future agent turns get codebase orientation in one pass instead of ad-hoc grepping.

## Map
- CLI entrypoint (bash → node) → `docgen` · (bash wrapper)
- Core walker, staleness detection, analysis loop → `docgen.mjs` · `walkDirs`, `walkDirsBottomUp`, `needsAnalysis`, `analyzeOne`, `analyzeAllParallel`, `selectFiles`, `assembleContext`
- State persistence (which dirs analyzed, file content hashes) → `docgen.mjs` · `loadState`, `saveState`, `computeInputsHash`, `parseInputsHash`
- Semver versioning for generated docs → `docgen.mjs` · `parseVersion`, `bumpType`, `resolveVersion`
- `migrate` subcommand (rename old docgen-marked `README.md` → `AUTO_DOCS.md`) → `docgen.mjs` · `migrate`, `hasDocgenMarker`
- Context injection hook (PreToolUse, fires before Read/Edit/Grep/Glob) → `inject-readme-context.mjs` · (no exports; stdin→stdout Claude Code hook contract)
- LLM-as-judge single-dir validator → `validate-readme.mjs` · `validateReadme`, `buildReadmeValidatePrompt`, `parseReadmeValidation`, `judgeCommand`, `selectDirFiles`, `withRetry`
- Batch validator (all `AUTO_DOCS.md` in repo, stamps quality score into version header) → `validate-all.mjs` · `stampScore`
- Prompt template (fed verbatim to `claude -p` for generation) → `prompt.md`
- Tests → `docgen.test.mjs`, `inject-readme-context.test.mjs`, `validate-readme.test.mjs`

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `claude -p` subprocess — called by `analyzeOne` for generation and by `validateReadme` for LLM-as-judge scoring; overrideable via `DOCGEN_JUDGE_CMD` env var
- `.docgen/state.json` at repo root — durable staleness state written by `saveState`, read by `loadState`
- `.docgen/global.md`, `.docgen-context.md`, `.docgen-cascade.md` — optional curated context files injected into prompts via `collectCuratedContext`
- `/tmp/docgen-injected-<session_id>.json` — per-session dedup cache written by the injection hook

## Gotchas
- `DOC_FILENAME = 'AUTO_DOCS.md'` is the only file docgen writes; it intentionally never touches `README.md` (humans own that). Code that reads "the docs" must look for `AUTO_DOCS.md`, not `README.md`.
- Staleness is content-hash based (not mtime), so a fresh `git clone` — where every file's mtime is the checkout timestamp — does NOT trigger re-analysis of unchanged files. `needsAnalysis` returns `null` when hashes match even if mtime advanced.
- The injection hook (`inject-readme-context.mjs`) must never exit non-zero — Claude Code treats non-zero hook exits as "block this tool call." All errors are swallowed and the hook emits nothing instead.
